Rina (People Ops): :wave: Heads-up: launching three small policy updates today — a Short-Term Medical Leave Top‑Up pilot, a PTO Micro‑Donation widget, and Travel Vaccination Reimbursement for higher-risk trips. TL;DR and links below.

Tom (People Ops): Short-Term Medical Leave Top‑Up: eligible employees may get up to 80 hours paid top-up (in addition to PTO/sick) for urgent medical or caregiving crises. Requires manager + People Ops approval and verification docs.

Lila (Payroll): Admin note: top-ups draw from a central fund for the pilot. If approved, we’ll post the hours to payroll as paid leave the next cycle. Eligibility: FT employees with 3+ months tenure; part-time pro‑rata.

Jo (Eng): If someone needs intermittent days over several weeks, can they spread the hours?

Tom (People Ops): Yes — you can request a split schedule in the form; approval will include a schedule so payroll knows when to apply the hours.

Rina (People Ops): PTO Micro‑Donation widget: donate as little as 2 hours (increments of 2) into a team fund. Donations convert to a dollar balance and can be earmarked for a named colleague or the general emergency pool. Donors can opt for anonymity.

Lila (Payroll): Conversion uses donor base hourly rate at donation time. When funds are used, recipients get hours restored at their base rate. We’ll show a preview of the dollar value before you confirm a donation.

Sam (Security): Travel Vaccination Reimbursement: up to $300 per trip for company‑recommended vaccines/expedites when traveling to higher‑risk regions on company business. Submit receipt and clinic note; Security will flag eligible trips automatically.

Jo (Eng): Does this include flu shots for team offsites?

Sam (Security): No — only vaccines specifically recommended for the destination by WHO/CDC or local health authorities for company‑funded travel. Flu shots for routine travel are not covered.

Rina (People Ops): New process note: for any company‑funded customer site visit or sponsored offsite, attendees must complete a short Code‑of‑Conduct acknowledgement during travel preapproval. Reimbursements and travel booking approvals will be blocked until it’s completed.

Tom (People Ops): If you need an accommodation to the CoC acknowledgement (religious/medical/accessibility), DM People Ops or use the confidential review form and we’ll provide an alternate path.

peopleops-bot: Reminder configured: "CoC ack due" will ping registered company‑funded travelers 7 days and 48 hours before departure.

Rina (People Ops): Forms and FAQ: Medical Top‑Up request: https://forms.redwood/medical-topup; PTO micro‑donation: https://forms.redwood/pto-microdonate; Vaccine reimbursement: https://forms.redwood/travel-vax-reimburse. QA session tomorrow 12:30pm PT in #people-ops-ama.

Jo (Eng): Appreciate the options. If someone wants a private consult for a sensitive case, is #people-ops-confidential active?

Tom (People Ops): Yes — DM us and we’ll move to #people-ops-confidential or schedule a private call. Thanks all.
